notes.title: Nyan-Nyan Punch! Remake Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088285/0906243c789d69d3fff07b83d97445913993f836.png

Nyan-Nyan Punch presents a new look through the remake update! Many changes and additions have been made, including:

 Improved graphics and cutscenes
 More diverse and character-fitting attack patterns 
 New stages: 'Kila' the killer whale, and 'Rafi' the chameleon
 Hidden bonus side story after the ending
 Variety of additional abilities and purchasable items for the player
 Various basic attacks to be used in addition to punch
 Miscellaneous QoL updates

This remake update is only available to users who have purchased the game. The pre-update build will be available as the "Original" version, and please note that save files are not compatible between these two versions.

Thank you to everyone who played the game, and we hope you enjoy the remake.
